title: A habit tracker that roots for you
caption:
A habit tracker that roots for you 🌱

Each check fills the ring around your habit, and when it’s full it sparkles. Miss a day and nothing breaks.

Daily Charm is free to start on the App Store (iPhone). Search “Daily Charm”.

#habittracker #habits #cozyapps #productivity #dailycharm

veo.prompt: Stop-motion style scene of a tiny cozy room with a rug, a potted plant and a framed picture on a cream wall. Very subtle motion: the plant's leaves sway slightly, soft sunlight shifts slowly across the wall. Nothing new appears: no characters, no animals, no people, no objects are added, and nothing moves from its place. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, soft warm even light, calm and cozy.
